name: Douglas DC-6 / C-118
summary: Four-engine piston airliner built 1946–1958 and the basis of the military C-118; a handful still work as cargo and firefighting aircraft.

engines: Four large Double Wasp radial engines in round nacelles along the wing
fuselage: Long, round pressurized fuselage with a row of rounded-square windows
Large cargo door forward on freighters
tail: Single tall fin with a straight horizontal tail

tellTales: Four radial piston engines with big propellers
Single tall fin on a long, round fuselage
Tricycle gear on an old-fashioned airliner

confusedWith.howToTell: The DC-3 has two engines, a taildragger stance and is far smaller; the DC-6 has four engines and a nose wheel.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
